at least one actual nonempty E and E-control request; T injection coverage reported; absent gate coverage => pause, not replacement
saved-record validation without dispatch; documented scope stops and fractions retained

matrix.formula: sum(task_box_count * 4 remote methods * 1 repeat); local/singleton sends zero; no credit recycling

order: sources sorted by preregistered hash within length bins; within source registry insertion order; first admitted source all six methods is technical gate
scope: known POSE_HEIGHT_MISMATCH and declared conservative monitor range stops remain UNASSESSABLE, invalidate pair, retain full denominator; coverage reviewed without choosing by benefit
stop_batch: unexplained or previously unregistered scope reason
